Nascemos em 2017 com o propósito de ser a melhor empresa de saneamento para o Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios consiste em concessões e parcerias público-privadas (PPPs).

Somos uma das principais companhias de saneamento do país, inserida na vida de comunidades de diferentes portes e atendendo milhões de pessoas.

Inovação, sustentabilidade, geração de valor e foco na satisfação do cliente fazem parte da nossa cultura organizacional. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação com a gente!

  • Controlar as ordens de serviço, qualidade e quantidade dos serviços em andamento e/ou concluídos, acompanhando o andamento e assegurando o correto atendimento da solicitação;
  • Dirigir veículos da empresa para execução das tarefas em ambiente externo, reportando qualquer incidente, zelando pela segurança, normas de trânsito estabelecidas e manutenção dos veículos.

Requirements and skills

  • Desejável: Ensino Superior Engenharia Civil, Manutenção, Sanitária ou áreas correlatas.

description:
Supervisor de Prevenção de Perdas I Itaboraí - RJ.

Join to apply for the Supervisor de Prevenção de Perdas I Itaboraí - RJ role at americanas s.a.

Descrição da vaga

Nossa história resume bem o que somos: uma combinação entre nosso potencial e a dedicação de quem acredita que limites existem para serem superados. Sabemos que para ganhar o jogo precisamos dos melhores talentos e estamos aqui para jogar a longo prazo. Por isso, procuramos pessoas que queiram evoluir continuamente e se desafiar a construir algo relevante para nossos clientes. Foram a ambição e o trabalho dos nossos associados que nos trouxeram até aqui e que continuarão a nos levar adiante. Por isso, buscamos os melhores profissionais, que sejam obcecados por gerar resultados através do time, liderando uma equipe de alta performance. Se identificou? Então venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Visitas em loja: responsável por realizar auditorias presenciais das rotinas e processos em um grupo específico de lojas, efetuando as correções e ajustes necessários para assegurar o controle e a redução de perdas e quebras nas localidades, conforme metas pré-estabelecidas.
  • Tratativa dos indicadores críticos: responsável por monitorar, através de painel de indicadores e imagens, as informações atreladas a perdas e quebras das lojas, identificando possíveis desvios e agindo proativamente para corrigi-los.
  • Investigação de fraudes e desvios: responsável por apurar fraudes, quebras de procedimentos e desvios de mercadorias nas lojas através do canal de denúncias, visitas em loja e análise do painel de indicadores.
  • Acompanhamento de inventário: Responsável por acompanhar a organização e preparo das lojas para a realização de inventários, diagnosticando os resultados e elaborando um plano de ação junto às lojas para melhorar esses resultados.
  • Acompanhamento dos resultados: responsável por realizar reuniões semanais, quinzenais e/ou mensais para atualizar e apresentar resultados, discutir estratégias, e treinar a equipe de prevenção e os associados das lojas nos procedimentos preventivos.
  • Atuação em sinistros: responsável por identificar e implementar ações para mitigar e reduzir ocorrências de sinistros em determinadas localidades, além de fornecer o suporte necessário à loja após um sinistro, garantindo a execução adequada do procedimento pós-sinistro e prevenindo possíveis reincidências.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação completa;
  • Domínio do pacote office – Intermediário/avançado;
  • Habilidade analítica e estratégica;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Perfil direcionado a resultados;
  • Senso de urgência;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

Será um diferencial se você possuir

  • Conhecimento prévio em Prevenção de Perdas;
  • Vivência com Looker ou Power BI;
  • Conhecimento com sistemas de CFTV;
  • Vivência com SAP.

Local de Trabalho

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em Itaboraí/RJ.

Benefícios

  • Regime CLT;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Proposta salarial de acordo com plano de cargos e salários, pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em lojas físicas após período de experiência;
  • Meetups e eventos de troca de conhecimento e plataforma interna com cursos e treinamentos;
  • Ambiente colaborativo perfeito para ensinar e aprender.

Quem Somos

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito: Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito: Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência. Valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, e comprometemo-nos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos.

Diversidade e inclusão: A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Construímos a cada dia uma cultura baseada no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência.

title: MÉDICO CIRURGIÃO VASCULAR - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
MÉDICO CIRURGIÃO VASCULAR - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do hospital conta com dez andares, distribuídos entre emergência, unidades de terapia intensiva (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal, maternidade, clínica médica, cirurgia geral, bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos na Zona Oeste, região atendida pelo hospital, há duas enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial, dispondo de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções graves em pacientes com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, com 39 leitos, que absorve demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII livre para casos de risco de morte, cirurgias urgentes e internações. Este CER possui atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prestar atendimento nas enfermarias, centro cirúrgico e Unidade de Terapia Intensiva do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Medicina.
  • Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista na área.
  • Registro ativo no conselho de classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 6 (seis) meses comprovada na função.

O hospital está localizado em Santa Cruz - RJ. A carga horária varia entre 10h, 12h e 24h semanais, dependendo da vaga.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviço, com vínculo de parentesco ou atuação em diferentes modalidades contratuais, devem consultar as normativas de RH vigentes junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma entidade civil sem fins lucrativos, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, atuando em vários níveis na gestão de serviços e organizações de saúde, com foco na promoção da saúde e na prevenção de doenças, atendendo a todos sem discriminação.

A organização busca expandir suas ações na área social e educacional, consolidando-se como uma grande instituição filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade social, econômica e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, instituições afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são geridas por profissionais altamente capacitados, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços do SUS, garantindo acesso universal e de qualidade à saúde, apoiada por equipes multiprofissionais qualificadas.

O PAIS , iniciado em 2001 em São Paulo, estende-se a outros municípios e estados, buscando melhorar indicadores de saúde e a qualidade de vida, pautado nos princípios de integralidade e equidade, com gestão estratégica e aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM promove oportunidades de trabalho para pessoas com deficiência, com planos de carreira e anúncios periódicos divulgados nos principais jornais das regiões onde atua.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade em todos os níveis de assistência para a população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Email Marketing Associate
description:
About Darkroom


Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.


At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.


Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.


About the Role


We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug-and-play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem-solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands-on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.


Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance, while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.


This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.


A Day in the Life



  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data-driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e-commerce clients.


  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.


  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages


  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.


  • You’ll work directly with our in-house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to live, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.


  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers.


  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.


  • Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

title: MÉDICO PEDIATRA - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do hospital conta com dez andares, onde estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência, Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia geral, bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região atendida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial dos serviços oferecidos, dispondo de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos e tem como objetivo absorver demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e internação. Um diferencial do CER é o atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

As atividades incluem realizar consultas no Pronto Atendimento Pediátrico, unificando dados de prontuários e prescrevendo medicamentos; visitar pacientes internados, avaliando sua recuperação; encaminhar pacientes para exames, tratamentos e cirurgias específicas quando necessário.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior completo em Medicina
  • Residência Médica ou especialização na área
  • Registro ativo no conselho da classe
  • RQE em Pediatria
  • Experiência em Pediatria

Carga horária: 12h semanais.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviços, com vínculo de grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou atuando em outra modalidade contratual, devem seguir as normativas de RH vigentes, consultando o setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de caráter filantrópico, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

Atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e educação, além de ser uma organização social habilitada em vários estados, gerenciando serviços e organizações de saúde via convênios e contratos de gestão.

A missão da instituição é sua inserção no sistema de saúde, focada no tratamento, prevenção de doenças e promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, fortalecendo vínculos com a comunidade e atendendo a todos sem discriminação.

Com crescimento institucional, a SPDM expande suas áreas de atuação, incluindo projetos na assistência social e educação, consolidando sua posição como uma grande instituição filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são gerenciadas por profissionais altamente capacitados.

A SPDM contribui para a melhoria contínua dos serviços do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS), garantindo universalidade e acesso à saúde, combinando tecnologia avançada com atendimento de alta qualidade por equipes multiprofissionais, incluindo enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades em 2001 em São Paulo, expandindo para outros municípios e estados. Seu objetivo é melhorar indicadores e a qualidade de vida, seguindo princípios de integralidade e equidade, com gestão estratégica e aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho com plano de carreira para pessoas com deficiência em suas unidades hospitalares, realizando publicações periódicas de anúncios em jornais principais de São Paulo e regiões atendidas.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, de forma ética, humanizada, com alta qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços de saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade em todos os níveis da assistência para a população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

description:
O Hospital Maternidade Maria Amélia Buarque de Hollanda integra a Rede de Atenção materno-infantil e ginecológica no Município do Rio de Janeiro. Suas ações tem por objetivo garantir a integralidade na linha de cuidado, visando a ampliação e qualificação do acesso humanizado das gestantes à assistência hospitalar. Seus processos e fluxos assistências estão ancorados no acolhimento com classificação do risco e em Diretrizes Clínicas baseadas em evidências que viabilizam a resolutividade e a qualidade na atenção prestada.

Inaugurada em 2012 a Maternidade oferta atividades assistenciais nas 24 horas do dia, todos os dias da semana, inclusive sábados, domingos e feriados.

O Serviço possui papel estratégico na atenção perinatal em articulação com os demais serviços da Rede de Atenção à Saúde, articulada com a rede de atenção primária à saúde da AP 1.0 e regiões circunvizinhas.

  • Realizar avaliação nutricional dos pacientes conforme indicação médica, prescrever dietas, de forma a promover à segurança, manutenção e recuperação da saúde;
  • Elaborar levantamento das prescrições dietéticas dos prontuários dos pacientes para elaborar o mapa de dietas;
  • Identificar as necessidades, promover e colaborar com planejamento, organização e atividades de ensino, treinamento no aperfeiçoamento do serviço;

  • Supervisionar a distribuição das dietas/produtos distribuídos aos pacientes que tenham indicação ao suporte nutricional;
  • Avaliar sinais clínicos, medidas antropométricas (peso, altura e IMC) e acompanhar os exames laboratoriais, conforme Manual de Nutrição Clínica;
  • Prescrever dietas enterais quando houver indicação médica;
  • Visitar diariamente os pacientes para inteirar-se da aceitação da refeição servida;
  • Documentar no prontuário dos pacientes a evolução dietética para que o médico possa acompanhar;

  • Orientar de forma nutricional os pacientes em alta;
  • Estabelecer normas e rotinas para o serviço em acordo com a Coordenação do Setor;
  • Seguir rigorosamente as normas de vigilância sanitária;
  • Elaborar relatórios administrativos, estatísticos conforme necessidade;
  • Participar das ações de parceria entre a unidade de saúde e as instituições de ensino, considerando a indissociabilidade da relação entre ensino e serviço, apoiando o desenvolvimento de campos de estágio, pesquisa e/ou residência no seu setor de trabalho;
  • Apoiar e propiciar condições para aquisição de conhecimentos no campo profissional de estagiários e/ou residentes nas atividades assistenciais sob sua responsabilidade, quando solicitado e conforme avaliação junto ao gestor imediato;
  • Observar o cumprimento dos aspectos éticos envolvidos na assistência ao usuário, quando os espaços de atendimento e a realização de procedimentos envolva a participação de estagiários, pesquisadores e/ou residentes;

  • Step 3: Avaliação 3 Avaliação

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Especialista de Transportes e Logística , AMXL
description:
Our logistics teams are transforming the way we interact with customers around the world, every day, and solving some of the biggest logistics challenges faced not only by Amazon, but by the entire industry. Whether items are large or small, we develop solutions to ensure that we deliver on our promise to the customer.

Amazon Logistics Brazil (AMZL) is looking for a Logistics Operations Specialist to join the AMXL (logistics operations for large items) team. This person will be the focal point for operational activities carried out by third‑party partners. The operations take place 7 days a week, including holidays, with a 4x3 scale, distributed between front and back office teams.

The professional will be responsible for managing delivery stations operated by external logistics partners, ensuring the performance, compliance, and standardization of processes. It will play a fundamental role in tactical execution aimed at growth, expansion and maintenance of quality and operational excellence.

You will work in a highly collaborative, dynamic and fast‑paced environment — closer to a start‑up than to a large corporation. We adopt the mindset that no idea is bad and that the best ideas should be tested and tried.

It's essential that this person is able to thrive in an ambiguous and fast environment, delivering consistent results. Some of the activities will be carried out remotely, while others will include audits and in‑person visits to the logistics partners' operations.

Key job responsibilities

  • Manage end‑to‑end the stations operated by logistics partners, ensuring efficiency, compliance, safety and the best customer experience.
  • Act operationally in managing the daily routine, ensuring the execution of processes, volume monitoring, and resolution of deviations.
  • Monitor and optimize operating costs, identifying opportunities to reduce expenses and increase productivity without compromising quality.
  • Manage operational capacity, anticipating peaks in demand and ensuring adequate resources, infrastructure, and teams for current and future volumes.
  • Develop, implement, and lead tactical and expansion projects, such as network adjustments and optimization of logistics flows.
  • Define and monitor strategic metrics and KPIs with logistics partners, implementing action plans to achieve or exceed goals.
  • Analyze data from multiple sources to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, using insights for critical and quick decisions.
  • Act as the main link between internal and external stakeholders, ensuring alignment of objectives, deadlines, and compliance.

A day in the life

The Logistics Operations Specialist manages the operation of outsourced delivery stations, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and quality. It acts both tactically, analyzing metrics, and operationally, following the daily routine and resolving deviations on the ground. It works in collaboration with internal teams such as Planning, Security and Supply Chain, as well as external partners. It is responsible for ensuring adequate capacity for peak demand and presenting business cases for improvements. The focus is on ensuring that large items are delivered with speed and excellence, ensuring the best customer experience.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Experience managing large data sets and utilizing them to drive performance and process improvements
  • Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
  • Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or equivalent
  • English skills
  • Experience with SQL

title: Presales Solutions Architect
description:
3 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants

We are a leading Product Development, Artificial Intelligence, and Team Augmentation studio with our eyes set on the future that crafts better futures for humanity by relying on cutting‑edge technology to create impressive digital products and solutions that widen your global reach. Our human‑centric approach guides us every step of the way and we’re proud of the impact our products make.

Are you someone who loves turning bold ideas into reality? Does the thought of experimenting with cutting‑edge tech and creating quick Proof of Concepts (POCs) excite you? At Arionkoder, our Innovation Team is searching for a Solutions Architect who thrives on pushing boundaries and sharing their journey through impactful communication. If you’re passionate about reshaping what’s possible with technology, we’d love to meet you.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement architecture: Design end‑to‑end technical architectures for engineering solutions that are modular, scalable, and easy to iterate on. Responsible across the innovation lifecycle from ideation, prototyping to deployment of technical architecture of AI solutions.
  • Define system components: Model layer, embedding logic, storage, orchestration, and observability, among others.

Security & DevOps

Review with security and DevOps team technical definitions inside the proposed architecture.

  • Lead technical discovery alongside our CTO, with the help of software developers.

  • Integrate Thoughtfully: Integrate AI/ML models into backend systems, optimizing their performance for scalable, real‑world applications.
  • Support pre‑sales efforts by providing technical guidance and accurate estimations.
  • Optimize and Secure: Build scalable, secure systems using AWS services and adhere to industry best practices. Build core services and APIs using Python, LangChain, FastAPI, etc. Ensure clean, maintainable code and efficient ML/data pipeline integration.
  • Mentor and Lead: Guide team members, sharing your knowledge and fostering a culture of curiosity and experimentation.

What We’re Looking For

  • Highly seasoned solution architect with 5+ years of experience and familiarity with AI solutions architecture.
  • Curiosity and Passion: You’re eager to explore emerging backend technologies and stay ahead of the curve.
  • Experimental Mindset: You are comfortable testing, iterating, and learning from feedback in fast iteration cycles.
  • Hands‑On Problem‑Solver: You’re driven to create, prototype, and refine solutions quickly, learning from successes and failures alike.
  • Estimations
  • Great Communicator: You excel at making technical ideas accessible, inspiring your team and the broader organization.
  • Team‑Oriented Mindset: You succeed in multidisciplinary teams and believe innovation is strongest when perspectives combine.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • High proficiency in Python and backend development.
    • Enterprise Architecture mindset with a breadth of cross‑functional domains and technologies/skillset.
    • Sound knowledge in Architectural Patterns, best practices, security and Non‑Functional Requirements.
    • Strong experience with AWS and/or Cloud services.
    • Familiarity with integrating AI/ML models into backend systems.
    • Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines.
    • Experience with security and safety standards in software engineering.
    • Knowledge of microservices using Kubernetes, Docker or similar tech.
    • Knowledge of Infrastructure‑as‑Code tools like Terraform or AWS CDK.

Extra Skills That Can Make You Stand Out

  • Familiarity with conversational AI, natural language processing (NLP), Computer Vision or ML‑based predictive models is nice to have.
  • Exposure to event‑driven architectures and message queues (e.g., SQS, SNS, Kafka).
  • Understanding of database optimization and performance tuning for both SQL and NoSQL databases.

Why Join Us?

At Arionkoder, innovation isn’t just a buzzword; it’s our way of working. As a Back‑End Developer on our Innovation Team, you’ll have the freedom to experiment with cutting‑edge technologies, build Proof of Concepts, and deliver impactful solutions that shape the future. From integrating advanced AI models to solving real‑world challenges, you’ll work at the forefront of technology in a team that values creativity, learning, and collaboration.

What Do We Offer

  • Competitive USD salary
  • 20 business days of vacation per year + 6 national holidays
  • Family Leave
  • A dynamic remote work culture. You can work from Anywhere!
  • An entrepreneurial environment.

About Us

In 2010 our founders dreamed up a company that could positively impact the world. Since then, we are in permanent evolution and revolution that brings us closer to our goal.

At first, we did it through business consulting. Then, we shifted towards innovation and design. And now, we've decided to go the Arionkoder way: entrepreneurial vision and creativity are in our DNA, and this is the time to turn them into a tangible reality. That’s why we create amazing digital products with the power to impact lives.

We have been dreamers and we still are. We loved it and looked forward to the next revolution!

title: Cloud & Industrial Edge Architect
description:
Snapshot of Your Day

You’ll help design and operate the hybrid (on-prem + cloud) infrastructure that powers Siemens Energy’s industrial digitalization solutions. With solid experience in Microsoft Azure and working knowledge of GCP and AWS, you’ll contribute to building secure, reliable, and scalable connections between industrial (OT) environments and cloud platforms, enabling data services, analytics, and smarter operations.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Support the design and implementation of hybrid architectures connecting edge/on-prem systems with the cloud.
  • Deploy and maintain cloud and edge components for data ingestion, storage, and monitoring.
  • Enable secure OT–IT integrations (VPN, private links, authentication, certificates).
  • Develop Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD automation practice.
  • Monitor and tune performance, cost, and reliability of deployed environments.
  • Work closely with automation, data, and product teams to bring industrial data into digital platforms.
  • Participate in solution reviews, proposals, and technical discussions with internal and external partners.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years crafting, building, and operating cloud/hybrid infrastructure for production systems.
  • 3+ years hands‑on with Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS, networking, security, IAM, monitoring).
  • Exposure to GCP or AWS (some practical experience is welcome, not mandatory).
  • Strong hybrid integration skills: site-to-cloud connectivity, private networking, DNS, certificates, edge/IoT.
  • IaC & DevOps: Terraform (or Bicep/ARM), Git-based workflows, pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps), artifact registries.
  • Containers & Orchestration: Kubernetes/AKS (or similar), registry, ingress, telemetry, backup/DR patterns.
  • Awareness of data flows from OT systems (OPC UA, MQTT, or equivalent).
  • Security-by-design approach (identity, secrets management, policy-as-code, vulnerability management, compliance).
  • Effective collaborator communication with multi‑functional and international teams.
  • Degree in Engineering (any), Computer Science, or proven equivalent experience.
  • Proficient English, knowledge of other languages is an asset.
  • Relevant certifications (Azure, GCP, AWS) are a plus.
  • Familiarity with edge runtimes (Azure IoT Edge, Kubernetes at the edge), time‑series/observability stacks.

About The Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Growing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H₂ and derivative fuels will rise. Our focus is on decarbonizing manufacturing and adopting balanced approaches with industry clients, global networks, tech, and coordinated implementation.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than ~100,000 dedicated employees, we generate electricity for over 16% of the global community and use our technology to protect people and the environment. Our cross‑border team is committed to redefining the energy sector by exploring new possibilities to achieve balanced, reliable, and affordable energy solutions. We uphold a 150‑year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Our Office

Siemens Energy's location in One Cotroceni Park is not just an office space – it's a hub for a vibrant and growing community! Nestled in the heart of Bucharest, this urban development is the flawless place to work, surrounded by green spaces, shopping destinations, and everything the city center has to offer. The Academia Militara subway station is just a 3‑minute walk away, making city travel easy.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is motivated by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

  • Flexible work schedules guaranteeing a good work‑life balance.
  • Access to ongoing professional and personal development through our training programs.
  • Lunch with SE meal tickets.
  • Bookster for book lovers.
  • Medical subscription for safety and stability.
  • Private Pension Pilon III for future planning.
  • Wellbeing Initiatives to look after yourself.

Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando seus consumidores a viverem jornadas únicas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.

title: Staff Platform Engineer, Americas
description:
We’re looking for a curious, rigorous, problem-hungry platform engineer (who codes!) to carry the ball as we bring Ashby to the big leagues. Ashby builds software that lets talent teams build an efficient, delightful, respectful hiring process. Similarly, you’re an engineer who wants to build a “paved road” that excellent engineering teams can safely take to the moon and back.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, over 2500 customers, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet, but you now probably have a good idea as to why we’re hiring for this role.

We’ve listed this role twice: as a Platform Engineer and Site Reliability Engineer – our team does both, and we are open to candidates who lean towards one or the other.

About the role and how we work

Hi I’m Colin, Head of EMEA Engineering. I’ve spent a number of years leading engineering teams in startups, and that has always included being close to infrastructure teams - no matter what name they’ve worn (SRE, infrastructure, platform, etc). I’ve got my hands dirty building the initial infrastructure for startups and know the value a talented infrastructure engineer brings. The rigour, the discipline, the peace and quiet when everything just hums along.

Our infrastructure is in a good place for now. Nothing is static. Ashby continues to grow rapidly, putting strain on our existing infrastructure. We’re always looking to give our customers more powerful hiring software, and building new product features often requires new pieces of infrastructure.

Having herded plenty of snowflake servers in the past, I’ve learned there’s a better way. I (and Ashby) place a lot of value on code-as-infrastructure. As a Platform Engineer at Ashby, you’ll get to dive into scaling problems, add new capabilities to our platform, and think about how our entire team interacts with infrastructure. All our own engineers own their projects end-to-end and ship with minimal oversight. We don’t put roadblocks to ensure security when common sense will do and we don’t build processes like change management boards around the lowest common denominator. But with great power comes great responsibility: we handle personal and confidential data about some of the biggest decisions we ever make at work. As we grow, more and bigger customers rely on us to be reliable and secure and how we operate internally will need to evolve.

We’re at an inflection point where our ability to scale and deliver a seamless experience has a make-or-break impact – we have some of the fastest growing companies using our platform every day to hire hundreds of people per month. We need someone like you to make good decisions, debug thorny issues, and build us a future-proof platform that can withstand this scale. Our small but mighty infrastructure team has set up a secure and simple environment (we don’t believe in spinning up a new service unless necessary!) for our growing product team to build in. That’s where you come in: you, too, will own projects end-to-end and have an impact on core parts of the Ashby developer and user experience. For instance, you could work on:

  • Optimize our homegrown ultra-dynamic recruiting DSL-to-SQL compiler, and create tools to help developers do so
  • Create automated guardrails for the security and privacy of our customer data
  • Help our developers ship features fast through canary deploys, gradual rollouts and feature flags, while keeping complexity manageable and reducing downtime
  • Work with the business and the engineering team to define SLOs and implement the corresponding SLIs.
  • Ensure all communication with external services supports circuit-breakers.
  • Implement the infrastructure to support an event-driven architecture and data warehouse.

Why you should or shouldn’t apply

You should apply if:

  • You never stop. You get weirdly obsessed about a problem that doesn’t yet make sense, turn it every which way in your head until the explanation dawns. You’ll search every rock, inventory every clue, hunt every mismatch. We do that, too – together we’ll be armed with state‑of‑the‑art monitoring tools and an impressive amount of data, and join you in the adventure.
  • You don’t take shortcuts. You’re speaking up for the future user, the edge case, the doomsday design. You know product engineers want to build it with you, and see them as allies, where you give them the power and knowledge to access greater things.
  • You’re someone who cares about what you do and the team you do it with, and want to work with others who do as well. You’ll be on interview panels choosing your next colleagues, and you’ll take that seriously. You only want to work with people who make you better, and want to make you better.
  • You’ve built infrastructure at a slightly later stage than Ashby is at - you know how to deal with millions of data points, have seen great (or not great) infrastructure make or break customer experience, and have automated everything from provisioning to monitoring and release process.
  • You’re a Swiss army knife (all nationalities welcome). You’ll get every hard problem the company faces. You’ll get to do infrastructure updates, security enforcements, database optimization, Kubernetes debugging, and digging through Typescript traces figuring out what doesn’t work. You probably don’t feel like an expert at at least some of that… and that appeals to you.

You should not apply if:

  • You don’t want to make your own decisions on what is the best paved road to build for Ashby, and expect a lead or manager to make the final call on what that is. Our leads (and managers) give ample commentary and feedback on technical decisions and how they’re made, but you ship what you want to build and are accountable for it.
  • You hate SQL. We have a lot of features built around making the best out of data, and our platform engineers also sometimes dive into a gnarly report or advise engineers on a more performant data model to use.
  • You don’t want to code. Our SREs are some of our best software engineers and they are just as responsible for the application as the other engineering teams – albeit at a platform level. Reviewing code and submitting code changes will be part of your day to day.
  • Your primary mode of communicating best practices to engineers is live meetings. We’re a very async culture and written communication (and code) is how changes get made. As an Ashby SRE, you will need to share new tooling and best practices with engineers faster than your next meeting opportunity will take you.
  • You’ve never delivered a project, on your own, without someone prodding you for updates. We have no project or delivery managers to fill your calendar with busy work, but the flip side is you have to do your project management, seek the help you need to get unstuck and cut scope when it’s worthwhile.

Technology Stack

We use TypeScript (frontend & backend), Node.js, React, Apollo GraphQL, Postgres, Redis. We use Datadog and Sentry on 100% cloud‑based (AWS) infra. We take developer experience and reliability seriously: all engineers are on call in a follow‑the‑sun model, and everyone contributes to developer tooling.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity.
  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
  • Unlimited PTO, and we will encourage you to take it.
  • A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, covered by Ashby. For folks outside the US, it may be longer to be in line with regional requirements.
  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
  • If you’re in the US, we offer top‑tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high‑quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

title: Principal Platform Engineer, Americas
description:
We’re looking for a curious, rigorous, problem-hungry platform engineer (who codes!) to carry the ball as we bring Ashby to the big leagues. Ashby builds software that lets talent teams build an efficient, delightful, respectful hiring process. Similarly, you’re an engineer who wants to build a “paved road” that excellent engineering teams can safely take to the moon and back.

We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, over 2500 customers, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet, but you now probably have a good idea as to why we’re hiring for this role.

We’ve listed this role twice: as a Platform Engineer and Site Reliability Engineer – our team does both, and we are open to candidates who lean towards one or the other.

About the role and how we work

Hi I’m Colin, Head of EMEA Engineering. I’ve spent a number of years leading engineering teams in startups, and that has always included being close to infrastructure teams - no matter what name they’ve worn (SRE, infrastructure, platform, etc). I’ve got my hands dirty building the initial infrastructure for startups and know the value a talented infrastructure engineer brings. The rigour, the discipline, the peace and quiet when everything just hums along.

Our infrastructure is in a good place for now. Nothing is static. Ashby continues to grow rapidly, putting strain on our existing infrastructure. We’re always looking to give our customers more powerful hiring software, and building new product features often requires new pieces of infrastructure.

Having herded plenty of snowflake servers in the past, I’ve learned there’s a better way. I (and Ashby) place a lot of value on code-as-infrastructure. As a Platform Engineer at Ashby, you’ll get to dive into scaling problems, add new capabilities to our platform, and think about how our entire team interacts with infrastructure. All our own engineers own their projects end-to-end and ship with minimal oversight. We don’t put roadblocks to ensure security when common sense will do and we don’t build processes like change management boards around the lowest common denominator. But with great power comes great responsibility: we handle personal and confidential data about some of the biggest decisions we ever make at work. As we grow, more and bigger customers rely on us to be reliable and secure and how we operate internally will need to evolve.

We’re at an inflection point where our ability to scale and deliver a seamless experience has a make-or-break impact – we have some of the fastest growing companies using our platform every day to hire hundreds of people per month. We need someone like you to make good decisions, debug thorny issues, and build us a future-proof platform that can withstand this scale. Our small but mighty infrastructure team has set up a secure and simple environment (we don’t believe in spinning up a new service unless necessary!) for our growing product team to build in. That’s where you come in: you, too, will own projects end-to-end and have an impact on core parts of the Ashby developer and user experience. For instance, you could work on:

  • Optimize our homegrown ultra-dynamic recruiting DSL-to-SQL compiler, and create tools to help developers do so
  • Create automated guardrails for the security and privacy of our customer data
  • Help our developers ship features fast through canary deploys, gradual rollouts and feature flags, while keeping complexity manageable and reducing downtime
  • Work with the business and the engineering team to define SLOs and implement the corresponding SLIs.
  • Ensure all communication with external services supports circuit-breakers.
  • Implement the infrastructure to support an event-driven architecture and data warehouse.

Why you should or shouldn’t apply

You should apply if:

  • You never stop. You get weirdly obsessed about a problem that doesn’t yet make sense, turn it every which way in your head until the explanation dawns. You’ll search every rock, inventory every clue, hunt every mismatch. We do that, too – together we’ll be armed with state‑of‑the‑art monitoring tools and an impressive amount of data, and join you in the adventure.
  • You don’t take shortcuts. You’re speaking up for the future user, the edge case, the doomsday design. You know product engineers want to build it with you, and see them as allies, where you give them the power and knowledge to access greater things.
  • You’re someone who cares about what you do and the team you do it with, and want to work with others who do as well. You’ll be on interview panels choosing your next colleagues, and you’ll take that seriously. You only want to work with people who make you better, and want to make you better.
  • You’ve built infrastructure at a slightly later stage than Ashby is at - you know how to deal with millions of data points, have seen great (or not great) infrastructure make or break customer experience, and have automated everything from provisioning to monitoring and release process.
  • You’re a Swiss army knife (all nationalities welcome). You’ll get every hard problem the company faces. You’ll get to do infrastructure updates, security enforcements, database optimization, Kubernetes debugging, and digging through Typescript traces figuring out what doesn’t work. You probably don’t feel like an expert at at least some of that… and that appeals to you.

You should not apply if:

  • You don’t want to make your own decisions on what is the best paved road to build for Ashby, and expect a lead or manager to make the final call on what that is. Our leads (and managers) give ample commentary and feedback on technical decisions and how they’re made, but you ship what you want to build and are accountable for it.
  • You hate SQL. We have a lot of features built around making the best out of data, and our platform engineers also sometimes dive into a gnarly report or advise engineers on a more performant data model to use.
  • You don’t want to code. Our SREs are some of our best software engineers and they are just as responsible for the application as the other engineering teams – albeit at a platform level. Reviewing code and submitting code changes will be part of your day to day.
  • Your primary mode of communicating best practices to engineers is live meetings. We’re a very async culture and written communication (and code) is how changes get made. As an Ashby SRE, you will need to share new tooling and best practices with engineers faster than your next meeting opportunity will take you.
  • You’ve never delivered a project, on your own, without someone prodding you for updates. We have no project or delivery managers to fill your calendar with busy work, but the flip side is you have to do your project management, seek the help you need to get unstuck and cut scope when it’s worthwhile.

Technology Stack

We use TypeScript (frontend & backend), Node.js, React, Apollo GraphQL, Postgres, Redis. We use Datadog and Sentry on 100% cloud‑based (AWS) infra. We take developer experience and reliability seriously: all engineers are on call in a follow‑the‑sun model, and everyone contributes to developer tooling.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity.
  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
  • Unlimited PTO, and we will encourage you to take it.
  • A minimum of 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, covered by Ashby. For folks outside the US, it may be longer to be in line with regional requirements.
  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
  • If you’re in the US, we offer top‑tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high‑quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Job Title: Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners

Role Summary

The Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners will play a key role in M&O Partners’ commercial growth by representing our suppliers’ products and services to shipyards and shipowners across the maritime and offshore sectors. Reporting directly to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore and working closely with the Sales Manager , this position focuses on identifying new business opportunities, strengthening client relationships, and supporting the successful introduction of supplier solutions to shipbuilding, conversion, and vessel maintenance projects. The Sales Executive will engage directly with shipyards, vessel owners, and technical teams, delivering value‑based proposals and ensuring M&O’s solutions are well‑positioned to meet client needs and project requirements.

Product & Solution Representation

  • Develop a deep understanding of the suppliers’ products and their applications within shipbuilding, repair, and conversion projects.
  • Provide technical and commercial presentations tailored to shipyards and shipowner requirements.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier technologies, certifications, and industry standards.

Business Development

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with shipyards, shipowners, and related stakeholders in the maritime and offshore markets.
  • Build and manage a pipeline of qualified prospects through proactive outreach, industry networking, and relationship building.

  • Share market insights and customer feedback with internal teams and supplier partners to guide strategic decisions.

Sales Strategy & Reporting

  • Support the development and execution of sales strategies aligned with M&O’s objectives in the marine and offshore sectors.
  • Maintain accurate records of opportunities, client interactions, and pipeline status within the CRM system.
  • Provide regular reports on sales activities, forecasts, and market developments to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore.

Skills and Competencies

  • B2B Sales Expertise: Proven track record in technical, industrial, or maritime sales.
  • Client Relationship Management: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and long‑term partnerships with shipyards, shipowners, and technical teams.
  • Technical & Market Knowledge: Understanding of marine equipment, systems, or components used in shipbuilding and vessel maintenance.
  • Negotiation & Commercial Acumen: Skilled in managing bids, pricing discussions, and contract finalization processes.
  • Strategic Thinking: Capable of identifying business opportunities through market analysis and strategic planning.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver value‑driven commercial solutions.

Experience Requirements

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in B2B technical or industrial sales, preferably within the maritime, shipbuilding, or offshore sectors.

  • Familiarity with procurement processes and technical specifications for marine and offshore projects.
  • Background in mechanical, electrical, or marine engineering is a plus.

Other Information

Job function: Sales, Consulting, and Administrative

title: Voice and Services Engineer
description:
About 1GLOBAL

1GLOBAL is a technology‑driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best‑in‑class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licences, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL delivers seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. The company serves leading banks, corporations and digital‑first businesses, connects over 43 million devices worldwide and operates as a fully regulated MVNO in ten countries and a regulated telecom operator in 31 more. Established in 2022, it employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

As a Network Engineering member in the Voice and Services functional area, you will be responsible for proposing, analyzing, and defining the requirements for new and existing services and systems related to the voice systems under the responsibility of the functional area. You will prepare, design, test, and provide new solutions or product changes to the existing portfolio and support the technology evolution roadmap for the systems under the functional area. Participation and support of other functional areas on cross‑functional projects are also part of the role.

We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successful candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon.

Fluency in English is essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing projects for delivery of new solutions.
  • Project delivery, network design, integration, and migration strategy definition. Responsible for end‑to‑end delivery.
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions.
  • Creation and maintenance of technical documentation (HLDs, LLDs, WOs, etc.) throughout the lifecycle.
  • Implementation in live environment; understanding of end‑to‑end system testing requirements.
  • Follow‑up and definition of quality and performance indicators.
  • Capacity and performance analysis, reporting, and improvement solution definition.
  • Service and resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems.
  • Work on complex solutions that influence current product design and address future product or technology issues.
  • Maintain close relationships with external partners such as carriers and service providers.
  • Elaborate and manage the process for change requests to current partners to meet network necessities.
  • Control the network elements roadmap, ensuring necessary software/hardware upgrades during the component lifecycle.
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including cross‑team processes.
  • Document the existing technology portfolio and propose recommendations for improvements or alternatives.

Requirements

Must Have

  • Proven experience implementing live solutions on mobile telecom networks (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS).
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications.
  • Experience designing, testing, and operating NGN‑based networks, including MSS/MGW, HLR/HSS, SBC.
  • Experience defining, establishing, and maintaining SIP/RTP‑based voice interconnects.
  • Understanding of IMS architecture, VoIP, VoLTE, VoWiFi, QoS.
  • Experience with SMS service configuration and routing.
  • Knowledge of IMS nodes (P/S/I‑CSCF, Application Servers).
  • Knowledge of IMS protocol interfaces (Gm, ISC, Sh, Cx, SOAP/XML, etc.).
  • Experience in mobile services charging, including offline/online OCS, Ro, Ro+, Ga, Bp interfaces.
  • Knowledge of Diameter/SCTP networks and protocols.
  • Knowledge of signalling gateways and protocols, including SS7, SIGTRAN, MAP, CAMEL.
  • Experience using protocol analyser tools such as Wireshark, Astelia.
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions.
  • Familiarity with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s).
  • English proficiency mandatory; other languages a plus.
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

  • +3 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks.
  • Previous experience with Nokia, Oracle, and Ribbon IMS products.

Benefits

  • CLT contract – job stability and reliable benefits.
  • Quarterly performance bonuses.
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card – R$100 per working day.
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica – 50% covered by the company.
  • Extended parental leave – 180 days maternity, 20 days paternity.
  • Daycare allowance for mothers with children under 3 years – R$500 per month per child.
  • Onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin).

1GLOBAL is an equal‑opportunity employer. Diversity drives our innovation and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment.

Na AUTOMOB , você terá a oportunidade de desenvolver suas habilidades, expandir seus conhecimentos e construir uma carreira de sucesso em um ambiente dinâmico e desafiador. Oferecemos soluções completas para nossos clientes, desde a venda de veículos até serviços de pós-vendas, como oficina, funilaria e pintura.

Se você é apaixonado por carros, tem sede de conhecimento e busca um lugar onde suas ideias são valorizadas, a AUTOMOB é o seu destino! Venha acelerar conosco e fazer a diferença em uma empresa que valoriza a diversidade e a inclusão em todas as suas formas.

Os benefícios tradicionais que você já conhece, nós também temos. Queremos te mostrar que vamos além. Saiba mais!

Benefícios

  • LIGADO EM VOCÊ: Atendimento especializado para a nossa gente e familiares por meio de uma central 24 horas para apoio psicológico, sobre saúde, social, familiar, financeiro e/ou jurídico e tudo isso com sigilo absoluto.
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade estendidas + Kit nascimento para recém-mamães e recém-papais.
  • Sabemos o quanto a educação das crianças e adolescentes é importante. Aqui na AUTOMOB , damos aquela ajuda na compra do kit escolar para os filhos da nossa gente.
  • Nossa gente tem acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma de descontos em viagens, cultura e entretenimento, serviços, gastronomia, educação e bem-estar.

O sonho que começou em 1995 com a primeira Concessionária Volkswagen, ganhou força e se transformou no maior e mais diversificado grupo de Concessionárias do Brasil.

Nossa devoção em servir é parte da nossa cultura, temos um time altamente capacitado e que compartilha dos mesmos valores: GENTE, CLIENTE, SIMPLICIDADE, ATITUDE DE DONO, SUSTENTABILIDADE E LUCRO.

CSC-PRESCRIBED QUALIFICATION STANDARDS

Education: Master’s Degree or Certificate in Leadership and Management from the CSC

Experience: Four (4) years of supervisory/management experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION STANDARDS

Education: Master’s Degree preferably in Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Management, Office/Business Administration, Public Administration, Community Development, Economics, Sociology, Human Resource Management and/or Accounting

Training: At least 48 hours of training on supervisory/management related to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality assurance/control, volunteers’ deployment, human resource, procurement processes, planning, monitoring and evaluation, budget preparation, and capacity building

Experience: At least five (5) years’ experience on supervisory / management related to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers’ deployment. Must also have experience in disaster operations

Eligibility: Career Service (Professional); Second Level Eligibility

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Thorough understanding of RA 10121: Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act
  • Must have enough knowledge regarding government laws and processes
  • Above average knowledge on use of MS Office
  • Great attention to details
  • Above average knowledge in planning/organizing/accounting/monitoring and evaluation
  • Above average knowledge on the management of warehouse/logistics/production/donation facilitation/processing/monitoring/financial and quality control standard setting / institutionalization of volunteers’ assistance
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Able to work harmoniously, competently and effectively under pressure

JOB DESCRIPTION

Under direction and with substantial latitude for independent judgment, serves as the Division Chief and acts as the head of the Resource Management Division engaged in varied work ranging from routine to difficult and special work requiring training and moderate experiences or lower training but considerable experience and thorough knowledge pertaining to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers’ deployment.

FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Directs, supervises, coordinates the review of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies, guidelines, systems and processes pertaining to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers’ deployment.
  2. Implements policies / mechanisms to ensure transparency and efficiency of procedures in the receipt, inventory, valuation, utilization and reporting of procured and donated items.
  3. Recommends and supervises personnel that shall be assigned to assist in the donation facilitation in the “one‑stop‑shop” to be established by the government in times of disasters/calamities.
  4. Supervises the receipt, warehousing, processing, production/packing/repacking and releasing of procured and donated goods as allocated by the Disaster Response Management Bureau.
  5. Supervises the deployment of volunteers during the production/repacking of relief items in NROC and other production /repacking hubs that may be established/identified as extension of NROC during disaster relief operations.
  6. Coordinates the establishment of institutional partnership with other government agencies, non‑government organizations, private entities, people’s organizations, etc., for logistical support in the transport of FFPs to FOs / disaster‑affected areas / designated delivery sites consistent with the relief allocation plan and volunteer assistance during disaster operations at NROC.
  7. Monitors the compliance of DSWD Disaster Response Centers and Field Office on the required number and type of relief items for stockpiling and prepositioning at any given time.
  8. Submits reports and documentation pertaining to inventory management and recommends appropriate actions, policy improvement and submits recommendations necessary.
  9. Supervises the implementation of the relief allocation plan submitted by Disaster Response Management Group in a timely manner.
  10. Supervises the integration/consolidation of programs, activities and projects of NRLMB in the Work and Financial Plan which include targets, schedules and performance metrics.
  11. Submits outputs of subordinates against performance standards and provides inputs to the Head of NRLMB in rating the performance of subordinates and in identifying performance gaps and proposed staff development interventions.
  12. Resolves staff concerns and raises issues to the Head of NRLMB when beyond authority.
  13. Updates the Head of NRLMB on the status of its deliverables/tasks regularly.
  14. Provides supervisory and consultative assistance/services to the Head of NRLMB, partner/stakeholders and FOs and DRCs counterpart to address the challenges encountered on logistics and production in the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers’ deployment.
  15. Attends meetings, conferences and other activities on behalf of the Head of NRLMB as delegated.
  16. Acts as resource person during seminars/training/workshops related to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers’ deployment, as requested.
  17. Assures functions as the Head of NRLMB if the Head is on official travel/business or on leave of absence or other analogous circumstances resulting in inability to perform the duties of the position.
  18. Performs other tasks as may be required by the Head of NRLMB.

JOB OUTPUTS

  1. Enhanced policies, guidelines and procedures relative to logistics and production on the management of warehouse, transport, facilities, donations, repacking of relief goods, quality and volunteers’ deployment.
  2. Memorandum of Agreement with GOs, NGOs, POs, PAs, etc., relative to logistics and production during disaster operations.
  3. Proposed Operations and Contingency Plan.
  4. Consolidated Operations Reports (quarterly, semesterly and annually) of NRLMB.
  5. Updates, Memoranda and other office communications.
  6. Technical assistance to DRCs, FOs, LGUs, intermediaries and stakeholders.

CRITERIA FOR EVALUATION

Education: 25%

Training: 10%

Experience: 25%

IQT: 10%

Technical Exam: 15%

Interview: 10%

Performance Review: 5%

Total: 100%

INITIAL SHORTLISTING

Obtain 80% of the maximum total score or 48 points in Education, Training, and Experience (ETE).

FINAL SHORTLISTING

Top five (5) highest rating but overall rating should not be less than 85%.

APPLY NOW

  1. Application Letter stating the desired position, item number/code, and office/bureau/service/unit addressed to Director Jennifer M. Rizo, Director IV of Human Resource Management and Development Service; Please note that wrong or lacking information thereof shall render the application void.

  4. Photocopy of relevant Training/Seminar Certificates.
  5. Certificate/s of Employment (COE) – required for work experiences acquired outside DSWD Central Office.
  6. Copy of Special Order or Certification indicating the supervisory/management experience/functions signed by the HRMO or any authorized representative (for Division Chief positions only or as may applicable).

    • For RA 1080 Eligible (RSWs and/or other board passers only): photocopy of RA1080 rating / Verified Eligibility.
    • For CSC Passers only: photocopy of CSC rating / Verified Eligibility.
    • For BAR Passers only: photocopy of BAR rating / Verified Eligibility.
  8. Performance Rating in the last rating period or its equivalent, as may be applicable.

Note: (i) For those applicants from the public sector vying for promotion, a performance rating is required.   • Criar e manter pipelines de dados que automatizem a transferência e transformação de dados de maneira eficiente;
  • Implementar medidas de segurança para proteger os dados contra acessos não autorizados e vazamentos;

  • Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados e otimizar a escalabilidade e a eficiência;
  • Manter documentação completa e atualizada de processos, fluxos de dados e arquitetura de sistemas.

Requirements and skills

  • Ensino superior Completo;
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias, soluções e conceitos de Big Data;

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em desenvolver e manter pipelines de ETL para processar grandes volumes de dados, garantindo a qualidade e a integridade das informações;
  • Proficiência em Python;
  • Conhecimento dos recursos de nuvem GCP: Storage Transfer Service, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, DataFlow, BigQuery, Dataplex, Cloud Computer;
  • Experiência com Apache Airflow ou outras ferramentas para fluxos de trabalho de dados;
  • Experiência com soluções de armazenamento em colunas e/ou conceitos de data lakehouse;
  • Conhecimento em estratégias de CI/CD, infraestrutura como código (Terraform), observabilidade, entre outras;
  • Entendimento de como a otimização funciona em vários cenários e pode ser melhorada, como desempenho de consulta, escalabilidade de serviço e gerenciamento de cluster;
  • Curiosidade sobre tecnologias em rápida evolução no domínio da engenharia de dados e está ansioso para aprender e dominá-las, trazendo um impacto significativo para nossa equipe.

About the role

Our Engineering team helps Nubank to create and use the technology that provides us to build the best financial products. We strive for state-of-the-art software development practices that currently include a variety of technologies. While we value candidates that are familiar with them, we are also confident that software engineers who are interested in joining Nubank will be able to learn from our team. The software engineer is focused on software development with Clojure as the main programming language (We will teach you Clojure). Main responsibilities:

  • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging upon functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture
  • High throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka
  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS
  • Storing data in Datomic and DynamoDB
  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus
  • Running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.

You will be responsible for

  • Work with large scale distributed systems, understanding their broad architecture
  • Set technical direction for multiple teams, ensuring alignment with Business Areas and architecture strategies
  • Drive pragmatic innovation while ensuring resilient and flexible solutions that scale across products and geographies
  • Mentor engineers across teams, establishing and maintaining a high technical bar organization-wide
  • Write, test, instrument, document, and maintain code. Able to pair and participate in code reviews to contribute to the growth of others in and around the team
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new experiences
  • Ensure comprehensive observability, performance monitoring, and error handling across team services
  • Participate in on-call rotations for your team and respond to incidents as necessary
  • Work focused on backend applications, and be open to contribute to mobile and frontend development, according to business needs

We are looking for a person who has

  • At least 10 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies
  • Proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands (or even millions) of users
  • Strong background in object-oriented or functional programming languages, with ability to work across multiple languages
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives across multiple teams without direct authority
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across organizations
  • Practical knowledge of agile software development methodologies and previous experience with CI/CD
  • Good communication skills to prevent risks and explain trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Advanced English skills
